about_the_game:
Matter of Factory brings a whole new Local PvP experience! Battle with your friends in the fight to build and complete more orders!

"Work like your life depends on it, cuz it does..."

Compete for resources, build toys, sabotage your opponent, and survive random events to come out on top!

Play with your friends, or by yourself on multiple different maps, each with unique mechanics, to unlock skins, hats, and other customization items to show off your skill!

(Bragging rights included)

BUILD TO WIN

Fight to get the resources you need off of the conveyor belt, and build your order. Watch out for your opponent trying to sabotage you!

SABOTAGE YOUR OPPONENT

Steal sabotage tokens from the conveyor belt and spin the Sabaslot machine to get a competitive edge! Four different sabotages can be used strategically to stop (or just annoy) your friends!

 UPCOMING FEATURES IN DEVELOPMENT

Multiple Maps To Play!

Matter of Factory will come with multiple different maps to explore and play together, each featuring their own special mechanic and atmosphere! Unlock new maps by playing, and unlocking achievements.

Unlock Skins, Hats, and Trails to Customize Your Worker!

Complete certain achievements to receive a ticket! Use tickets to get a mystery box, unlocking a random item your player can wear!
